# ResizableHandle

The draggable line between two panels in a `ResizablePanelGroup`, a focusable window splitter (`role="separator"`) for the panel before it. Drag it, or focus it and use the arrow keys (10% a press), Home and End (that panel's smallest and largest size) and Enter (collapse the panel to its smallest size and back). It has a 44px hit area on touch screens.

```tsx
import { ResizableHandle } from "@/registry/ouro/components/ouro/resizable/resizable";
```

## Example

```tsx
<ResizableHandle />
<ResizableHandle aria-label="Resize the preview" />
```

## Use instead when

- Use `Resizable` instead, which places these for you.

## Props

Type: `ResizableHandleProps`.

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `aria-label` | `string` | This handle's accessible name, in place of the group's `handleLabel` ("Resize Files"). |

## Don't use

These are not props. Passing one fails the type check with the fix in the error, and in development a console message names the fix.

- `withHandle`: Not a prop. The handle always shows its grip: `<ResizableHandle />`.
